headline: Board accepted May 14, 2026 minutes and entered executive session to consider exemption and abatement applications.
summary: The board approved minutes from a prior meeting and had no new or old business to discuss. It then voted to enter executive session to consider Statutory Exemption and Abatement Applications and adjourned from that session.
decisions: Accepted the minutes of the May 14, 2026 meeting.
Voted to enter Executive Session to consider Statutory Exemption Applications and Abatement Applications, and to adjourn from Executive Session, 3-0 by roll call.

Methuen Board of Assessors Meeting Minutes 
September 3, 2026 
Assessor’s Office  
41 Pleasant St Ste. 103, Methuen, MA   
 
On the above date, the Board of Assessors met in person to consider all business to come before the Board.  Present at 
the meeting was Chairman Janet McLennan and board members Thomas J. Hoye, and Susan Davila.  Also, in attendance 
was Tristan Hoare, Chief Assessor, and Rossely Nunez, Clerk III for the assessor’s office. 
 
Janet McLennan made a motion to open the general meeting at 9:06 a.m., seconded by Thomas J. Hoye, the motion was 
unanimous. 
 
Thomas J. Hoye made a motion to accept the minutes of the May 14, 2026, meeting, seconded by Susan Davila, the 
motion was unanimous.  
 
New business: N/A 
 
Old business: N/A 
 
Thomas J. Hoye made a motion to end the general meeting at 9:14 a.m. seconded by Susan Davila.  
 
Thomas J. Hoye then made a motion to enter Executive Session at 9:16 a.m. to consider Statutory Exemption 
Applications, and Abatement Applications in compliance with the Open Meeting Laws purpose #7 (“To comply with, or 
act under the authority of, any general or special or federal grant-in-aid requirements”) and to adjourn the meeting 
from the Executive Session. The motion was seconded by Susan Davila, the motion was unanimously voted on by Roll 
Call vote: 
 
Vote: 
Chairman Janet McLennan- Yes 
Thomas J. Hoye-                    Yes  
Susan Davila-                         Yes  
  
The meeting was adjourned at 9:57 a.m. 
 
The next regularly scheduled Board of Assessors meeting will be held on October 1, 2026, at 9:00am.
